acceptancePlan.command: legion gh -- pr diff <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke  (and legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json files)
acceptancePlan.criterion: AC1: PR against sjawhar/legion-smoke adds exactly one new line to smoke.txt and changes no other file.
acceptancePlan.evidence: Diff shows +1 line in smoke.txt and files list contains only smoke.txt.
acceptancePlan.negativeControl: A diff that also touches any other path, or adds more than one line, fails AC1.

acceptancePlan.command: legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit  and  legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke.txt (default ref) to confirm the line.
acceptancePlan.criterion: AC2: PR passes required checks and merges to the default branch; the added line is present there.
acceptancePlan.evidence: PR state MERGED; smoke.txt on the default branch ends with the added line.
acceptancePlan.negativeControl: Reading smoke.txt on the default branch before merge does not contain the new line.
acceptancePlan.surface: Merged pull request state + default-branch contents of smoke.txt.

concerns: smoke.txt already exists at repo root (554B); the change is an append of exactly one line, not a create. The spec's create-if-absent branch does not apply here.
Change is plain text, not runtime code: this is a docs-only PR. ce-simplify-code and the thermonuclear deep-review/code-quality pair are omitted per legion-worker docs-only rule.
Required CI check is the `ci` workflow `check` job (.github/workflows/ci.yml: sleep 20 && exit 0) fired on push and pull_request.
In-scope anticipated follow-up: a review may request one more appended line to smoke.txt; the implementer appends it to the same file in the same PR (spec Requirements/Errors).
fileLevelWork: smoke.txt (root): append exactly one line of plain text to the end. This is the only tracked-code change in the PR.
No other repository file changes. .legion/<phase>.json handoffs are the only additional committed files, removed at the end of a clean review by the implementer's final push.
ordering: 1) implement: append line to smoke.txt, commit, set+push bookmark legion/S394135277-1, open PR (body: `Dispatch: S394135277-1`), record E2E (implementer). 2) test: verify AC1 on PR diff + AC2 setup, re-run proof, record implementerProof. 3) review: one round on the PR head, thread disposition, approve the head carrying no .legion/ (docs-only: no thermo pair, no ce-simplify). 4) merge: human merges; implementer confirms AC2 on default branch and records the production/default-branch check.

implement: legion-worker: drives the GitHub PR surface for this change — append one line to smoke.txt, set bookmark legion/S394135277-1, push it, open the PR whose body carries `Dispatch: S394135277-1`, and record the E2E (implementer) proof. No domain/build agent skill applies: the diff is plain text and sjawhar/legion-smoke has no source, build, lint, or test tooling.
review: legion-worker: defines the review round, per-thread disposition, and approval gate on the PR head. No domain review agent skill applies to a one-line plain-text diff, and the docs-only rule omits the thermonuclear pair.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester's proof discipline — verify the implementer's proof on the PR diff/merge surface, drive the same surface independently, and record implementerProof in .legion/test.json. No domain test agent skill applies; the only automated check is the `ci` workflow `check` job.

workflowRecommendation: Single implementer, one PR against sjawhar/legion-smoke. Docs-only text change: skip ce-simplify-code and the thermonuclear pair (no runtime code in the diff).
